sizeGuide.title: Size Guide
sizeGuide.how1: Place paper on the floor with your heel against a wall.
sizeGuide.how2: Mark your longest toe, then measure from the wall to the mark (cm).
sizeGuide.how3: Measure both feet in the afternoon and use the larger number.
sizeGuide.shoeCaption: US size to foot length in cm
sizeGuide.dancewearCaption: Dancewear sizes by body measurements in cm

notes.balletJazz: Ballet flats & jazz shoes should fit snugly with no room at the toes. Between sizes? Go smaller for canvas/stretch.
notes.pointe: Pointe sizes usually run 1–2 sizes smaller than street shoes, and box, vamp and shank all affect fit. Send us your foot photos & measurements on WhatsApp before buying.
notes.tapCharacter: Tap & Character shoes usually match your street size. Mind the heel height on Character shoes.
notes.ballroom: Latin/Ballroom shoes usually match your street size and stretch slightly with wear.
notes.dancewear: Choose by chest and hip. For a Leotard, torso length matters too.

sizeGuide.approxNote: Approximate chart. Each model can fit differently — ask us on WhatsApp if unsure.
sizeGuide.consultBody: Send us your foot length (cm) and a photo; we'll help you choose the right size & width.
